thread:
violet: ran the quick doc-scan on staging at ~22:30 — found 6 broken refs, one image 403, and a small frontmatter YAML list bug in guides/perf.md. nothing huge but blocking a batch of tiny PRs. can folks grab quick claims tonight?

sam: I can pick the 403 image. which path is it?

violet: assets/diagrams/latency-heatmap.png referenced from guides/perf.md — preview shows 403. report: /tmp/docscan/6912345678.json

ops-bot: doc-scan: staging report 6912345678.json created. items: 6 broken-internal-links, 1 asset-403, 1 frontmatter-list-parse.

mike: i'll take the frontmatter list — likely an extra dash on the tags list. small sed will fix, preview locally after.

anna: i'll grab the broken refs in /guides/auth (looks like renamed headings). drop the grep and i'll alias.

sam: for the image, try reupload to docs-cdn with public-read and update the path to a versioned file: `aws s3 cp latency-heatmap.png s3://docs-cdn/assets/diagrams/latency-heatmap-v2.png --acl public-read` then update the MD path.

mike: pushed PR branch docs/fix-frontmatter-6912 removing the stray dash and previewed with `yarn docs:preview` — looks clean. PR https://github.internal/redwood/pull/5220

anna: added HTML anchor alias for the renamed headings in guides/auth so old links resolve; opened PR https://github.internal/redwood/pull/5221

ops-bot: CI: queued docs-lint for PRs 5220,5221; running link-check and frontmatter parser.

violet: plan: merge after green CI, target merge window 00:45 UTC and deploy 03:00 UTC. if link-check still flags things, we'll do a manual sweep and tag leftovers as backlog.

sam: pushed image rehost branch docs/rehost-latency-img and updated path in MD; PR https://github.internal/redwood/pull/5222

mike: added myself to docs-owners sheet (tab: Guides) and left a note in the PR about ownership for follow-ups.

violet: thanks all — quick async win. i'll watch CI and post a one-line in #eng-status after deploy. if anything blocks, i'll @eng-oncall and open an incident stub.
